description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer class, specifically testing its watchdog timeout computation based on language and text length.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizerTests
classes.description: A test class for the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer, verifying timeout behavior for different language profiles and text lengths.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutDefaultsToLatinProfile
methods.description: Tests that the default timeout for Latin script text is approximately 24 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesKoreanProfile
methods.description: Tests that the timeout for Korean text is approximately 75 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesChineseProfile
methods.description: Tests that the timeout for Chinese text is approximately 84 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesJapaneseProfile
methods.description: Tests that the timeout for Japanese text is approximately 60 seconds.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutClampsVeryLongUtterances
methods.description: Verifies that extremely long text inputs have their timeout clamped to 900 seconds.
